assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
CPT 93229 Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is the service in question.
The appeal addresses Reason Code CO-197.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates prior approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
Failure to adhere to appeal deadlines may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
